Title: Analytics Engineering Lead
Location: Centro de San Pedro Garza García, Nuevo León, Mexico
Description: The Role The Analytics Engineering Lead is responsible for translating Clarios’ global data and analytics strategy into scalable, secure, and high-quality analytics solutions that enable data-driven decision-making across the organization. This role leads the technical design, development, and delivery of analytics products, metrics, integrations, and reporting capabilities while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, governance standards, and business priorities. Acting as a key technical leader, the Analytics Engineering Lead partners with business stakeholders, data scientists, architects, infrastructure teams, and global delivery teams to deliver innovative analytics capabilities that generate measurable business value and support Clarios’ strategic objectives. What You’ll Do (Impact Areas) Analytics Engineering & Solution Delivery Lead the design, development, and deployment of scalable analytics solutions that support business and operational decision-making. Ensure enterprise metrics are developed and deployed according to established global analytics standards. Own the technical execution of the analytics delivery backlog and roadmap. Translate business requirements into robust, secure, and scalable analytics solutions. Drive delivery of analytics use cases that align with business priorities and enterprise architecture standards. Technical Leadership & Architecture Provide strategic input to the Clarios Analytics technical roadmap, including platforms, tools, development practices, and emerging technologies. Partner with Enterprise Architecture teams to ensure appropriate architectural foundations are in place for analytics solution development. Establish technical standards, design principles, and best practices for analytics engineering. Evaluate and recommend technologies that improve analytics capabilities and business outcomes. Data Engineering & Analytics Enablement Collaborate with Data Scientists to transform raw data into predictive modeling and analytics-ready datasets. Oversee development of data pipelines, integrations, and data models that support enterprise analytics. Ensure data quality, consistency, security, and governance across analytics platforms. Enable advanced analytics, predictive modeling, and business intelligence solutions through effective data architecture. Project Delivery & Agile Execution Lead technical estimation activities and define resource requirements for analytics initiatives. Manage technical delivery teams operating in Agile environments across onshore and offshore locations. Ensure development activities remain aligned with project timelines, dependencies, and business expectations. Communicate project status, risks, issues, and progress effectively to stakeholders. Governance, Quality & Security Ensure all analytics solutions comply with Clarios architecture, security, governance, and quality standards. Maintain proper documentation, traceability, configuration management, and compliance with record retention policies. Oversee all aspects of solution delivery throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), including infrastructure, integrations, performance, disaster recovery, and support transitions. Drive operational excellence through quality assurance and continuous improvement practices. Advise business leaders on leveraging predictive analytics and data-driven insights to improve decision-making. Drive innovation by evaluating emerging analytics technologies and methodologies. Experience working with structured and unstructured data platforms. Strong proficiency in SQL, PL/SQL, and data manipulation tools. Experience with Power BI, Power Query, Power Pivot, SSAS, SQL Explorer, or similar Business Intelligence technologies. Experience working in Agile delivery environments with onshore and offshore teams. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Proven troubleshooting, performance tuning, and issue resolution capabilities. Ability to work effectively within matrixed business and technology organizations. Preferred Experience with Microsoft Azure analytics technologies including: Azure Machine Learning Azure SQL Data Warehouse HDInsight HIVE Talend (ELT) Experience with Snowflake or other cloud-based data platforms. Experience comparing and evaluating analytics and data technologies to determine best-fit solutions. Experience leading proof-of-concept initiatives and analytics innovation projects. Familiarity with predictive analytics, machine learning, and advanced analytics frameworks. Experience supporting enterprise-scale analytics transformations. Travel: Occasional domestic and international travel may be required to support business initiatives and stakeholder engagement. Collaboration Scope: Global, partnering with business leaders, data teams, infrastructure teams, vendors, and offshore delivery resources. Title: Analista de Control
Description: ¡En Iconn estamos en búsqueda de un nuevo Analista de Control Operativo ! ¿Qué actividades lleva a cabo un Analista de Control Operativo? Es responsable de recopilar, analizar y sintetizar información de las diferentes unidades de negocio para generar reportes, dashboards y análisis comparativos que permitan identificar desviaciones, detectar oportunidades y proponer mejoras en los procesos operativos. Será un enlace importante entre distintas áreas de la organización, facilitando información clave para la toma de decisiones. ¿Cuáles son sus funciones? Contribuirás al éxito de nuestra organización llevando a cabo las siguientes actividades: Recopilar y consolidar información de los administradores y jefes de patrimonio de las diferentes unidades de negocio. Analizar y sintetizar información proveniente de distintas áreas para generar reportes ejecutivos. Desarrollar dashboards y análisis comparativos entre plazas para dar seguimiento al desempeño operativo. Identificar resultados fuera de parámetros, desviaciones y áreas de oportunidad. Presentar hallazgos y compartir información relevante con gerentes de mercado, directores de operaciones y gerentes regionales. Proponer mejoras constantes en los procesos a partir del análisis de información e indicadores. Dar seguimiento a solicitudes de información y colaborar con diferentes áreas para asegurar la disponibilidad y calidad de los datos. Identificar obstáculos en la obtención de información y proponer alternativas para resolverlos. ¿Qué experiencia requerimos para la posición? A fin de ser considerado para la vacante, es necesario cumplir con los siguientes requisitos: Licenciatura concluida. Experiencia en análisis de datos, control operativo o generación de reportes. Manejo avanzado de Excel. Conocimiento de herramientas de visualización de datos como Tableau y Power BI. Experiencia en elaboración de dashboards y análisis comparativos. Capacidad para sintetizar grandes volúmenes de información y convertirlos en conclusiones accionables. Habilidades de comunicación oral y escrita, especialmente para presentar resultados y elaborar reportes. Pensamiento analítico, atención al detalle y proactividad para identificar y proponer mejoras. Capacidad para trabajar de manera autónoma y gestionar información con diferentes áreas. ¿Qué beneficios ofrecemos? Esta es una posición de planta, con esquema híbrido de trabajo Contarás con prestaciones superiores a la ley, incluyendo Vales de Despensa, Seguro de Gastos Médicos Mayores para ti y tu familia, Seguro de Vida, Fondo de Ahorro, Caja de Ahorro, entre otras. ¿Qué más necesito saber? Locación de la posición: Monterrey, Nuevo León. Es una posición sin personal a cargo, con interacción constante con diferentes áreas y niveles de la organización. Esta posición representa una oportunidad para tener visibilidad sobre distintas unidades de negocio, colaborar con líderes de la organización y continuar desarrollándote profesionalmente dentro de Iconn. No pierdas la oportunidad de unirte al equipo de Iconn ¡Aplica hoy mismo antes de que la vacante llegue a su fecha límite! Acerca de nosotros: Nuestra misión es satisfacer consistentemente las cambiantes necesidades de conveniencia de nuestros clientes y consumidores, ofreciéndoles la mejor experiencia de compra. En ICONN creemos que todas las personas tienen derecho a igualdad de oportunidades de empleo, por lo cual el procedimiento de reclutamiento y selección se basará en los requisitos inherentes a la posición a desempeñar. Por lo tanto, ICONN prohíbe la discriminación de empleados o solicitantes por motivos de raza, color, credo, religión, edad, género, preferencia sexual, discapacidad física, embarazo o cualquier otro factor.

Title: Lead Azure Data Engineer

Experience with Azure Cloud Services: Demonstrated knowledge of cloud platforms—specifically Azure—including storage, security, and resource optimization. Preferred Skills Experience working with Git-based version control (e.g., GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket) and familiarity with branching strategies, pull requests, and code review workflows. Focus on system maintenance: Strong emphasis on proactive detection and fast reactive maintenance of running jobs and pipelines. Other Requirements Ability to work under tight timelines and manage complex requirements. Flexible to work during CDT/EDT time zones and meet for hand-over activities to India team if needed. Title: Data Quality Specialist
Description: Job Description Why GM Financial? GM Financial is the wholly owned captive finance subsidiary of General Motors and is headquartered in Fort Worth, U.S. We are a global provider of auto finance solutions, with operations in North America, South America, and the Asia Pacific region. Through our long-standing relationships with auto dealers, we offer attractive retail financing and lease programs to meet the needs of each customer. We also offer commercial lending products to dealers to help them finance and grow their businesses. At GM Financial, our team members define and shape our culture — an environment that welcomes new ideas, fosters integrity, and creates a sense of community and belonging. Here we do more than work — we thrive. Our Purpose : We pioneer the innovations that move and connect people to what matters. This position will be posted until filled. Responsibilities About the Role GM Financial is seeking a highly skilled Data Quality Specialist to join the Data Governance Engineering team. The senior-level specialist is responsible for advancing enterprise data governance and data quality capabilities by implementing scalable, automated, and auditable processes that ensure the accuracy, integrity, and reliability of critical data assets. The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with governance leadership to drive trusted, compliant, and business-ready data across the organization. In This Role You Will Collaborate in the design and operationalization of enterprise Data Governance frameworks across Data Quality, Metadata Management, Data Lineage, Reference Data, and Critical Data Elements (CDEs), aligned to data governance principles and regulatory requirements. Title: Senior Data Scientist– Pricing
Description: Description - About the role HP's B2B Pricing Data Science team builds the analytics and ML systems that set and negotiate prices for commercial PC and Print products, sold both through channel partners and directly to business customers worldwide. Our pricing engine combines machine learning price and win-rate models, causal price elasticity estimation, and constrained optimization, and is deployed in live A/B pilots across multiple markets. We are expanding the team's global footprint to better support a global product. You will work at the intersection of econometrics and production data science: improving the causal inference core of our pricing algorithm, designing experiments to measure the impact of pricing and process interventions, and shipping your work as production-quality Python code. You will report directly to the team's manager, partner closely with our senior applied data scientist on methodology, and operate with a high degree of autonomy. What You Will Do Advance the causal inference components of our pricing system: price elasticity estimation (double/debiased ML, heterogeneous treatment effects), uncertainty quantification, and optimization logic. Translate methodological improvements into production-ready Python code, with tests, documentation, and adherence to team engineering standards. Contribute to the operational health of our production systems: incident support, model monitoring, and periodic retraining and validation cycles. Communicate findings and recommendations to technical and business stakeholders across time zones. What You Bring 4–5+ years of professional experience in data science, econometrics, or quantitative research, ideally with exposure to pricing, revenue management, or marketplaces. Strong grounding in causal inference and experimental design: potential outcomes framework, DML/orthogonalization, CATE estimation, instrumental variables, panel methods. Solid applied ML skills (gradient boosting, regularized regression) and the statistical judgment to know when a predictive model answers a causal question — and when it doesn't. Proficient Python for production: clean, testable, maintainable code; comfortable with the scikit-learn ecosystem, Git-based workflows, and code review. Hands-on experience with Databricks (or comparable cloud data platforms) for development and deployment. Title: Senior Machine Learning Platform Engineer — Model Hosting & MLOps
Description: Description - Role summary We are hiring a Senior Machine Learning Platform Engineer to build the infrastructure and engineering workflows that take custom models from development into reliable production use. This is a hands-on role for someone who has hosted LLMs on GPU infrastructure, developed the cloud platform around model serving, and built MLOps pipelines that make releases repeatable and observable. You will work with model developers, application engineers, security, and cloud platform teams to turn a model artifact into a secure, scalable inference service. The work spans serving architecture, infrastructure as code, deployment automation, model lifecycle management, and production operations across AWS and Azure, with potential integration into on-premises environments. You will also help shape agent workflows that use hosted models, so serving choices support the needs of multi-step applications. Success means teams can deploy, update, monitor, and troubleshoot models through clear, reusable platform patterns. What You Will Do Design and build hosting for custom ML and AI models across AWS and Azure, with particular focus on GPU-backed LLM inference and real-time endpoints; support batch inference where appropriate. Package models and their dependencies into reproducible serving workloads; choose and implement suitable managed services, containers, or Kubernetes-based patterns based on throughput, latency, security, reliability, and cost. Provision and configure Kubernetes clusters or other suitable hosting infrastructure, including compute, storage, API access, identity and access controls, secrets, networking integration, observability, and environment configuration. Help design secure connections and deployment patterns between cloud and on-premises environments as hosting needs evolve. Develop infrastructure as code and deployment automation so model-hosting environments can be provisioned, reviewed, promoted, and maintained consistently. Build MLOps workflows for model registration, versioning, validation, release, rollback, and retirement. Connect training or model preparation to deployment through automated pipelines and appropriate quality gates. Partner with application teams to design and prototype agent workflows, including model and tool orchestration, state handling, failure recovery, and evaluation. Translate agent workload patterns into hosting decisions about model selection, context length, concurrency, latency, cost, tool access, and end-to-end tracing. Establish production monitoring for service health, latency, throughput, errors, GPU and other resource use, and model behavior. Share responsibility for diagnosing incidents and improving capacity, reliability, and cost. Create reusable deployment templates, reference architectures, documentation, and onboarding paths that help other teams ship models safely. Partner with model and application teams on practical tradeoffs such as online versus batch inference, managed versus self-hosted serving, scaling, evaluation, data handling, and operational ownership. Required Experience Hands-on experience hosting LLM inference on GPU infrastructure in a production environment. You can explain what you personally built, how models reached production, and how you managed throughput, latency, utilization, reliability, and cost. Experience building the surrounding model-serving platform for custom models, such as inference runtimes, deployment patterns, endpoint access, scaling, and operational tooling. Strong software engineering skills, especially Python, with experience building services, automation, and maintainable production code. Experience developing infrastructure for ML workloads across AWS and Azure, with deep hands-on delivery in at least one and practical ability to work in the other. You have used infrastructure as code such as Terraform or an equivalent tool. Experience provisioning, configuring, and maintaining Kubernetes or another production hosting platform for containerized inference workloads. Experience building or operating ML deployment pipelines with versioned artifacts, automated validation, CI/CD, environment promotion, and rollback. Familiarity with LLM agent patterns, including model invocation, tool calls, and multi-step workflows, and how they affect serving capacity, reliability, and access controls. Working knowledge of production concerns for inference services: scaling, latency, availability, logging and metrics, shared incident response, access control, and cost. Ability to work across model development, application, platform, and security teams; turn ambiguous requirements into a working design; and document the resulting operational approach. Helpful Experience Advanced GPU inference optimization, including capacity planning, batching, autoscaling, memory use, model loading, and performance tuning. Serving generative or other compute-intensive custom models beyond LLMs; selecting and tuning inference servers and runtime configurations. AWS SageMaker or EKS; Azure Machine Learning or AKS; or equivalent managed and self-hosted model platforms. Hybrid or on-premises model hosting, including connectivity, security boundaries, hardware constraints, and operational handoff. Model registries, experiment tracking, data or feature pipelines, scheduled retraining, model evaluation, and drift or quality monitoring. Secure enterprise deployment patterns such as private networking, IAM/RBAC, secrets management, auditability, and handling sensitive data. Building shared ML platform capabilities or self-service workflows used by multiple engineering teams. Hands-on development of agent workflows, including tool integration, evaluation, tracing, or guardrails. Title: Sr. Data Scientist, Financial Services Mexico
Description: Description Lead the development, validation, and governance of the full suite of risk models for a high-growth payment product in Mexico, directly shaping the analytical foundation that drives every business decision across the product lifecycle. If you thrive on building scorecards from the ground up — starting with external data and expert-rule frameworks when proprietary data does not yet exist, then architecting the transition to custom models as portfolio mature — this is your opportunity to establish and scale a risk modeling function from inception. As Sr. Data Scientist, you will own the end-to-end model roadmap spanning origination, behavioral, delinquency propensity, collections, recovery, analytical fraud, and reserve input models. You will define development standards, documentation practices, versioning protocols, and monitoring frameworks with the rigor required to withstand audit scrutiny and regulatory review. Your work is both tactical and strategic: you will manage complex, cross-functional model programs with negotiated and defined obligations, influencing roadmaps, business and technology decisions, and model governance across the organization. Success in this role is measured by discriminatory power (KS, Gini) and its stability over time, Population Stability Index (PSI) of variables and scores, development-to-implementation cycle time, and the absence of validation findings. In a new product, the first 12 to 18 months are typically operated with generic or bureau scorecards and expert rules; this role requires someone who knows how to launch without proprietary data and plan the deliberate transition to custom models built on proprietary performance data as vintages mature. Key job responsibilities You will own and execute the model roadmap covering origination scorecards, behavioral scorecards, delinquency propensity models, collections and recovery models, analytical fraud models, and reserve inputs (PD, LGD, EAD). You will manage the full model lifecycle: development, validation, approval, implementation, ongoing monitoring, recalibration, and retirement. You will develop the origination scorecard, including reject inference methodology, and lead feature engineering across external data sources, and partner transactional data. You will build behavioral scorecards,payment propensity, contactability, and recovery models and produce PD, LGD, and EAD inputs for reserves calculation. You will own model validation end-to-end: conducting conceptual soundness reviews, replicating results, performing stress testing and stability analysis, and issuing formal opinions with findings, severity classifications, and remediation timelines. You will produce complete technical documentation and model files to the standard required for third-party review. A day in the life You will join working sessions with the risk team to translate champion/challenger experiment results into model refinement priorities, and calibrate payment propensity and contactability models against real-world recovery outcomes. You will coordinate with engineering to validate that deployed model versions match approved specifications and prepare the model performance package for the credit and risk committees. About The Team We are a team at Amazon building a new business, and we sit within the Payments organization. Today the team is small by design, which means you will have an outsized role in shaping our credit risk function, processes, and culture from day one. Our closest partners span finance, technology, and commercial teams, and together we are investing in creating a world-class underwriting and credit risk capability. If you want to help define something new at Amazon and see your work directly reflected in the product, we would love to hear from you. Basic Qualifications 5+ years of data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, Matlab, etc.) experience 4+ years of data scientist experience Experience with statistical models e.g. multinomial logistic regression Preferred Qualifications 2+ years of data visualization using AWS QuickSight, Tableau, R Shiny, etc. experience Experience managing data pipelines Experience as a leader and mentor on a data science team Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. Title: Human Data Quality Engineer (Founding Team)
Industries: Construction, Software Development, and IT Services and IT Consulting
Description: Human Data Quality Engineer (Founding Team) Prolific Prolific isn’t just enabling AI innovation – we’re redefining it. While foundational AI technologies are becoming commoditized, Prolific’s human data infrastructure provides the high-quality, diverse data required to train the next generation of AI models. Through our platform, we empower researchers and companies to access a global, ethically curated participant base, ensuring cutting-edge AI research and training grounded in inclusivity and precision. The Role As one of the founding members of Prolific's newly formed AI Data Services team, you'll help build the quality systems behind some of the world's most advanced AI models. Data quality is a strategic priority for Prolific, so this is a high-visibility role with direct exposure to senior stakeholders. This isn't a traditional QA role. We are not looking for someone to review data against a predefined checklist. We are looking for an innovative thinker that can leverage their expertise to define what good means where no definition exists yet. Acting as a strategic thought partner, you’ll work at the intersection of human data, machine learning, evaluation across frontier use-cases that define what high-quality human data looks like for the next generation of advanced AI. This means that much of the work involves novel problems with no established answer, so you’ll be comfortable working through ambiguity.. . Your primary focus is working directly with clients and alongside frontier AI labs, translating what their models need into robust human data and evaluation strategies. Rather than checking quality at the end of a project, you'll engineer quality into every stage of the lifecycle, from study design and participant strategy through to evaluation, launch readiness and client delivery.You will also work alongside our product engineering, and supply teams to define and build the quality infrastructure that will enable us to deliver high quality human data at scale. Much of the work you'll tackle won't have an existing playbook. You'll help create it. What You’ll Be Doing Design the quality frameworks that underpin complex human data programmes, from evaluation rubrics through to launch readiness. Work with clients as a strategic thought partner, challenging annotation schemas and data requirements when they won't produce the signal the model needs. Advise on project design and how the choice of schema can impact data quality. Build quality upstream across the operational workflow, from recruitment, screening, and training through to writing guidelines and running calibration sessions. Build scalable quality systems, measurement frameworks and automated checks using Python and SQL. Partner with product and engineering to build the quality infrastructure that delivers high-quality human data at scale. Investigate data quality and integrity issues, identifying root causes and turning insights into scalable improvements. Architect and build dashboards, monitoring and reporting that provide clear visibility into quality and operational performance. Raise the quality capability across the company, upskilling operations and acting as a thought mentor to junior analysts. Help define how Prolific approaches quality across new AI domains, shaping best practice as the team grows. What You’ll Bring to the Role 5+ years of experience in building quality, evaluation or annotation systems within AI, machine learning, LLMs or human data environments. Strong Python and SQL skills, with a passion for using data to solve complex quality problems. A solid understanding of machine learning pipelines and how human data impacts model performance. Strong analytical and statistical thinking, with experience designing scalable quality frameworks. The confidence and credibility to interact with stakeholders at frontier labs and act as a partner. The ability to leverage your experience and expertise to influence and guide stakeholders at every level, both client side and internally. in The ability to turn your own data analysis and quality methodology into requirements that product and engineering can build into systems. The ability to explain yout data analysis and findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders, so they can act on them. A proactive, builder's mindset -you enjoy creating new systems, navigating ambiguity and improving how things work. Even Better if you have: Experience with LLM evaluation, RLHF, AI safety or red teaming. Experience translating vague model or evaluation goals into clear annotation specifications. Experience working with human annotation programmes or human data operations. Familiarity with calibration, inter-rater agreement, drift detection or other evaluation methodologies. Why Prolific is a great place to work We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems. We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breath and the best of humanity. Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research. Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission-driven culture. At Prolific, our compensation packages for eligible roles include base salary, equity, and benefits. Many roles also include the opportunity to earn a cash variable element, such as a bonus or commission. Each job posting shows a salary range that reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hires, based on the role’s location as well as your skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter will also be happy to share the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. You are business-first, consumer-focused and cost-conscious: you start from the decision a merchant, marketer or finance lead needs to make, know the cost per task of each model you run, ship early, improve weekly and fix data problems at the source. Advanced written and spoken English. Advanced use of AI: it is already part of how you work every day. A background in a quantitative field such as computer science, engineering, statistics, math, economics or data science. Title: Analytics Senior Associate
Description: We are PMG PMG, a global independent platform company engineered for impact, integrates business strategy, media, creative, and data within a single operating model powered by our proprietary operating system, Alli. With more than 1,000 employees, PMG partners with brands including Apple, Nike, Dropbox, Experian, Sephora, and Whole Foods. Our work has earned top industry honors, including Cannes Lions and Adweek’s Media Plan of the Year, and PMG has won 40+ workplace culture awards, including being the only company to rank among Ad Age’s Best Places to Work for 11 consecutive years. Who You Will Be Working With At PMG, our Analytics team is at the heart of turning data into insights that fuel smarter marketing, media, and business decisions. We go beyond surface-level metrics to help teams understand performance, improve measurement, and ensure the data and tools behind those decisions are accurate, reliable, and actionable. You’ll collaborate with media strategists, analytics leaders, data engineers, data scientists, and client teams to support the analytics data, reporting, measurement workflows, and technology that power our work. You’ll also work closely with PMG’s Alli platform, helping ensure its analytics capabilities and underlying data remain accurate, reliable, and usable for both internal teams and customers. As an Analytics Senior Associate, you’ll have the opportunity to strengthen your technical and analytical skills while solving real-world marketing challenges. From maintaining dashboards and analytics logic to troubleshooting data issues and supporting measurement initiatives, your work will help teams confidently use data to make better decisions. What You Will Be Doing Support internal teams and customers by ensuring analytics data, reporting, measurement workflows, and Alli platform capabilities remain accurate, reliable, and usable. Build, maintain, and improve analytics logic, dashboards, reports, trackers, taxonomy, automation, workflows, and platform capabilities. Support the development and maintenance of analytics solutions across data sourcing, transformation, validation, and visualization. Build and maintain dbt tests and other data-quality checks to identify issues and improve the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of analytics data. Monitor data sources and resolve freshness, quality, and availability issues, including completing backfills and reloads when needed. Investigate and troubleshoot reporting, data, platform, and performance issues, remediate alerts, and coordinate with the appropriate teams to drive resolution. Prepare and deliver accurate data for marketing measurement initiatives, including media mix modeling (MMM), LiftLab, lift studies, and other measurement workflows. Create and maintain clear media reporting that connects campaign performance to customer actions and business KPIs. Support Alli platform upgrades, enhancements, testing, and ongoing analytics capabilities. Partner with cross-functional teams, including Media, Client Strategy, Data Science, and Engineering, to support measurement strategies and analytics solutions aligned with customer objectives. Coordinate with stakeholders through consultation, documentation, onboarding, training, and ongoing support to improve adoption and usability of analytics tools and workflows. Identify opportunities to improve and automate recurring analytics processes, reporting, and data workflows. Stay current on marketing measurement, analytics tools, data practices, and emerging technologies, including AI and automation. What You Will Bring 1–3 years of experience in analytics, data analytics, marketing analytics, business intelligence, or a related field, with a bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience. Experience working with SQL to query, transform, validate, and analyze data. Familiarity with data warehousing platforms such as Amazon Redshift, BigQuery, or Snowflake. Experience with or exposure to data transformation and workflow tools such as dbt, including data-quality testing and validation. Experience building or maintaining dashboards and reports using visualization platforms such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker. Familiarity with digital marketing, media, or advertising data and an interest in understanding how data supports marketing decision-making. Exposure to marketing measurement concepts such as media mix modeling, lift testing, incrementality testing, attribution, or experimentation. Ability to investigate data discrepancies, troubleshoot reporting issues, and work across teams to identify and resolve root causes. Strong attention to detail and a proactive approach to maintaining data quality, consistency, and accuracy. Ability to manage multiple requests and priorities while delivering accurate, high-quality work in a fast-paced environment. Strong communication skills with the ability to document processes, explain analytical concepts, and provide support to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Familiarity with Python or R for analysis, automation, or data workflows is a plus. Experience with ETL/ELT pipelines, workflow automation, taxonomy management, or data quality monitoring is a plus. Experience working with marketing technology, ad tech, data clean rooms, or measurement platforms is a plus. A commitment to curiosity and adaptability as a Continual Learner, staying at the forefront of media innovation while prioritizing client success with a Customer-Focused mindset that seeks opportunities to deliver meaningful value. A People-Focused approach to collaboration, building strong relationships across teams and contributing to an environment where others can succeed. What We Offer Performance-Based Rewards: Your impact should be part of your reward. This role is eligible for PMG’s annual bonus program—a standout part of our total compensation offering and an opportunity to share in our success. Bonus awards are informed by individual impact and performance, as well as team and company results, and are subject to applicable program terms. Professional Development: Keep growing through learning and development programs, mentorship opportunities, and support for career advancement. Generous Time Off: Take the time you need to recharge, connect with loved ones, and enjoy life outside work. Parental Leave: Receive paid parental leave during life’s important family moments. Retirement Benefits: Build for your future with competitive retirement benefits, including employer contributions or matching where applicable. Fertility and Family Support: Access fertility and family-building benefits for eligible employees and their spouses or partners. Healthcare: Choose from medical, dental, and vision coverage designed to support you and your family. Pet Insurance: Access optional coverage for the four-legged members of your family. Lifestyle Spending Account: Receive company-funded support for eligible health and well-being expenses. Commuter Benefits: Access support for your commute where available. Volunteering Opportunities: Receive eight paid hours each year to give back to your community. AI Tools and Training: Access enterprise AI tools and ongoing training that helps PMGers use AI effectively, creatively, and responsibly. Our benefits and compensation programs may vary by location and eligibility and are subject to applicable plan terms. We’ll share full details during the hiring process. What Sets Us Apart Being part of PMG means joining a company culture that’s unmatched in digital. We're dedicated to working hard to serve our employees and clients, delivering value, results, and innovation—which often requires true grit and agility. We believe in taking care of ourselves and each other to continuously improve in every way. In alignment with our core values to be inclusive and always change for the better, PMG is committed to creating a more diverse and inclusive culture, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe that we only change for the better by bringing diverse perspectives to our company. PMG recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Title: Ai Product Builder
Description: AI Product Builder Improvado is an AI-powered, unified platform designed for marketing teams in medium to large-scale enterprises and agencies, who are looking to automate complex marketing intelligence and reporting to make decisions with ease. Improvado gathers, organizes, and untangles marketing data to deliver instant insights through BI and AI, helping to eliminate complexity, delivering laser-focused insights to optimize budgets, enhance campaign efficiency and marketing ROI. About the role As an AI Product Builder you own one product area end to end. Which area depends on where we need you most, and the work is the same in all of them. Our products turn marketing data into decisions, and each of them has the same failure mode: it tells the customer something and stops there. Your job is to find where your area stops short of causing a decision, build the part that closes that gap, and show that somebody acted. You will build hands-on with AI, shape the roadmap, work directly with engineering teams and with customers, and decide what a good recommendation looks like for a different persona on the same data - a media buyer, an analyst and a CMO do not want the same thing. Responsibilities Own the product area end to end, from idea to delivery, and define how the roadmap evolves Close the gap between what the product reports and what the customer does about it: decide what gets recommended and to whom, and build the loop that makes those recommendations better over time Work hands-on with AI, from mockups and prototypes through to production code for smaller features, alongside an engineering team of three to ten people Run customer discovery yourself and turn it into roadmap decisions Define and measure the metrics that prove the product caused someone to act Build and maintain automated workflows using AI tools, scripting and the modern data stack Collaborate with Product, BI and CSM teams on architecture decisions and customer data requirements Qualities Product ownership experience - able to take a problem end to end with minimal hand-holding, and point at things you built that are still in use Demonstrated use of AI tools in daily work: Claude Code, agentic coding, prompt engineering, with a clear view of what you deliberately do not delegate Experience building an AI agent and making it reliable in production Marketing or revenue data domain experience, and you have computed those metrics yourself rather than receiving them from an analyst Comfortable working with engineers as a peer rather than across a handoff Strong SQL ; Python for data processing and automation Fluent English - there are customer calls and escalations in this role Availability to overlap US Pacific business hours (or at least East) Nice to have Hands-on ETL/ELT pipeline experience (Big Query, Snowflake, Redshift, or Click House) Experience working directly with clients on technical requirements BI tools (e.g. Superset) for operational reporting Process A screening call, a 45-minute call with the VP of Product, a take-home designed for 90 minutes to two hours, and a review of it with our product managers. What We Offer Remote-first environment Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises Modern AI tech stack and freedom to experiment High-velocity team where you will constantly learn and scale your skills High autonomy and ownership - we care about outcomes, not hours AI-first, collaborative, no-bureaucracy culture with a technically strong, international team 20 working days of PTO per year US holidays and additional days off Professional development reimbursement

Title: Customer Intelligence Analyst II
Description: Company Description At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future. Job Description The Client Insights & Delivery (CID) Analyst is a foundational role within the Global Nielsen Campaign Analytics team, focused on delivering actionable recommendations that drive client success and market impact. As a member of this fast-paced, client-facing team, your primary responsibility is to work directly with media companies and advertisers to understand campaign objectives, advise on study setup, and provide performance analysis. You will assist in designing studies to measure ad effectiveness across all media platforms (digital, social, streaming, and podcasting) and perform deep-dive custom analyses under the guidance of senior members, all while maintaining a high level of quality assurance throughout every step of the process. Key Responsibilities Relationship Management: Build trust-based relationships with clients, Sales, Research, and Operations, acting as a partner to grow the business through Campaign Analytics (CA) solutions. Business Objectives: Help translate broad business needs into specific, measurable research questions that can be solved by Nielsen solutions. Research & Analysis: Design, execute, and present detailed research analyses, primarily focused on test vs. control methodology to determine the lift driven by measured campaigns. Client Delivery: Use Product knowledge to support clients in designing and executing studies. Analytically consult with clients on the results, ensuring insights and action-oriented solutions are delivered. Quality Assurance: Perform rigorous QA checks on test setup, data quality, and presentation materials to ensure best practices are strictly followed. Collaboration & Problem Solving: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to investigate issues, find the root cause, and proactively resolve them with appropriate parties. Project Management: Maintain accurate records of study timelines, milestones, and presentation dates, keeping all relevant internal and external stakeholders updated. Qualifications 2-3 years experience in analytics and/or media or marketing planning. Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills; ability to grasp new concepts easily and present them simply. Advanced level of English (written and verbal) is required. Excellent critical thinking ability and a desire to seek solutions for novel situations. A self-motivated, curious learner with strong project and time management skills. Ability to work quickly, adapt, and manage multiple projects at once. Technical proficiency in Office/Google Suite of software solutions. Strong Plus: Media and advertising industry knowledge, past experience in digital media buying/planning and marketing analytics, and experience with Syndicated data sets (Nielsen IQ and/or IRI) are all strong advantages.
